up: Retrieve up to 1000 activity rows where the standard type is IC50 and the pChEMBL value is not null, targeting the human single-protein target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL204 (Prothrombin). Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, taxonomy ID (tax_id), canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL204' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
